jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a new professional challenge? Bucher + Suter’s 160 employees have been the cornerstone of our success for over four decades. We are the largest Cisco Contact Center Partner in Europe and a melting pot of innovative minds, where every employee plays a vital role in our story. If you’re passionate about a career that both challenges and enriches you, your quest concludes here.

Main Tasks

You’ll be joining our dynamic operations team as a key player in modern contact center integration projects. You’ll work on-site with customers, from our offices, and remotely. Rest assured, you’ll have the support of experienced solution architects and system engineers.

As the central contact person for these projects, you’ll ensure they are completed to high standards, on time, and within budget. Your expertise and approachable demeanor will engage and motivate customers, partners, and internal team members.

If you’re ready to take the next challenge in project management, even if you don’t meet all the requirements yet, we encourage you to apply. We’re excited to get to know you!

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, project management, or engineering

• More than 5 years of experience leading IT, digital CX, digital product, AI or CRM projects

• Experience with contact center or calling projects is a plus

• You’re well-versed in cloud and unified communications technologies; if not, you want to learn

• Experience with Salesforce or other CRM solutions is a plus

• You enjoy direct contact with customers and partners and have excellent communication skills

• Experience with leading workshops is greatly appreciated

• You enjoy working as part of a team, are well-organized, and maintaining structure in your work

• You are certified in project management and/or agile methodologies (e.g., PMP, Prince2, IPMA, Scrum, etc.) and ideally, you are ITILv4 certified

• You are fluent in German and English and as a plus you are business proficient in French

What you can expect

• Hybrid working model and modern tooling

• Opportunities for career advancement through training, certifications, and technical courses

• Competitive salary with great benefits and perks

• Supportive team culture with experienced engineers

• Employee events, both locally and internationally

• Two paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) days per year

Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At Bucher + Suter, we believe that diversity drives innovation and success. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued and respected, regardless of their background, identity, or experiences. We welcome and encourage applicants from all walks of life to join our team and contribute to our shared goals.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stai cercando una nuova sfida professionale? I 160 dipendenti di Bucher + Suter sono stati la pietra angolare del nostro successo per oltre quattro decenni. Siamo il più grande Cisco Contact Center Partner in Europa e un melting pot di menti innovative, dove ogni dipendente svolge un ruolo vitale nella nostra storia. Se siete appassionati di una carriera che sia le sfide e vi arricchisce, la vostra ricerca si conclude qui.

Compiti principali

Ti unirai al nostro team di operazioni dinamiche come giocatore chiave nei progetti di integrazione di contact center moderni. Potrai lavorare in loco con i clienti, dai nostri uffici e da remoto. State certi, avrete il supporto di esperti architetti di soluzioni e ingegneri di sistema.

Come persona di contatto centrale per questi progetti, ti assicurerai che siano completati a standard elevati, nel tempo e nel budget. La tua esperienza e il tuo approccio demeanor coinvolgeranno e motivano clienti, partner e membri del team interno.

Se siete pronti a prendere la prossima sfida nella gestione del progetto, anche se non soddisfate tutti i requisiti ancora, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare. Siamo entusiasti di conoscervi!

Il tuo profilo

• Corso di laurea in informatica, gestione del progetto, o ingegneria

• Più di 5 anni di esperienza leader di progetti IT, digital CX, digital product, AI o CRM

• Esperienza con centro di contatto o progetti di chiamata è un plus

• Sei ben diversificato nelle tecnologie di comunicazione cloud e unificato; se non, vuoi imparare

• Esperienza con Salesforce o altre soluzioni CRM è un plus

• Ti piace il contatto diretto con clienti e partner e hai ottime capacità di comunicazione

• L'esperienza con i principali laboratori è molto apprezzata

• Ti piace lavorare come parte di un team, sono ben organizzati e mantenere la struttura nel tuo lavoro

• Siete certificati nella gestione del progetto e/o nelle metodologie agili (ad esempio PMP, Prince2, IPMA, Scrum, ecc.) e idealmente siete certificati ITILv4

• Sei fluente in tedesco e inglese e come un plus sei professionale in francese

Cosa ci si può aspettare

• Modello di lavoro ibrido e utensili moderni

• Opportunità per l'avanzamento della carriera attraverso corsi di formazione, certificazioni e corsi tecnici

• stipendio competitivo con grandi benefici e vantaggi

• Cultura di team di supporto con ingegneri esperti

• Eventi dei dipendenti, sia a livello locale che internazionale

• Due giorni di tempo libero (VTO) a pagamento

Dichiarazione di diversità e inclusione

A Bucher + Suter, crediamo che la diversità spinga innovazione e successo. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo dove tutti i dipendenti si sentono valorizzati e rispettati, indipendentemente dal loro background, identità o esperienze. Diamo il benvenuto e incoraggiamo i candidati da tutte le passeggiate di vita a unirsi al nostro team e contribuire ai nostri obiettivi condivisi.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sie suchen eine neue berufliche Herausforderung? Die 160 Mitarbeiter von Bucher + Suter sind seit über vier Jahrzehnten der Grundstein unseres Erfolgs. Wir sind der größte Cisco Contact Center Partner in Europa und ein Schmelztiegel innovativer Köpfe, in dem jeder Mitarbeiter eine wichtige Rolle in unserer Geschichte spielt. Wenn Sie sich für eine Karriere begeistern, die Sie sowohl herausfordert als auch bereichert, endet Ihre Suche hier.

Hauptaufgaben

Sie werden unserem dynamischen Betriebsteam als wichtiger Akteur in modernen Contact Center-Integrationsprojekten beitreten. Sie arbeiten vor Ort mit Kunden, von unseren Büros aus und aus der Ferne. Seien Sie versichert, Sie haben die Unterstützung von erfahrenen Lösungsarchitekten und Systemingenieuren.

Als zentraler Ansprechpartner für diese Projekte stellen Sie sicher, dass sie nach hohen Standards, pünktlich und im Rahmen des Budgets abgeschlossen werden. Ihre Expertise und Ihr ansprechbares Verhalten werden Kunden, Partner und interne Teammitglieder ansprechen und motivieren.

Wenn Sie bereit sind, die nächste Herausforderung im Projektmanagement anzunehmen, auch wenn Sie noch nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns, Sie kennenzulernen!

Ihr Profil

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Projektmanagement oder Engineering

• Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung von IT-, digitalen CX-, digitalen Produkt-, KI- oder CRM-Projekten

• Erfahrung mit Contact Center oder Calling-Projekten ist ein Plus

• Sie sind mit Cloud- und Unified-Communications-Technologien vertraut; Wenn nicht, möchten Sie lernen

• Erfahrung mit Salesforce oder anderen CRM-Lösungen ist ein Plus

• Sie genießen den direkten Kontakt zu Kunden und Partnern und verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Erfahrung mit führenden Workshops wird sehr geschätzt

• Sie arbeiten gerne als Teil eines Teams, sind gut organisiert und behalten die Struktur in Ihrer Arbeit bei

• Sie sind zertifiziert in Projektmanagement und/oder agilen Methoden (z.B. PMP, Prince2, IPMA, Scrum etc.) und idealerweise ITILv4-zertifiziert

• Sie sprechen fließend Deutsch und Englisch und sind darüber hinaus geschäftsfähig in Französisch

Was Sie erwarten können

• Hybrides Arbeitsmodell und moderne Werkzeuge

• Möglichkeiten für den beruflichen Aufstieg durch Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und technische Kurse

• Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit großen Vorteilen und Vergünstigungen

• Unterstützende Teamkultur mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren

• Mitarbeiterveranstaltungen, lokal und international

• Zwei bezahlte Volunteer Time Off (VTO) Tage pro Jahr

Erklärung zu Vielfalt und Inklusion

Bei Bucher + Suter glauben wir, dass Vielfalt Innovation und Erfolg vorantreibt. Wir sind bestrebt, ein integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle Mitarbeiter geschätzt und respektiert fühlen, unabhängig von ihrem Hintergrund, ihrer Identität oder ihren Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen und ermutigen Bewerber aus allen Lebensbereichen, sich unserem Team anzuschließen und zu unseren gemeinsamen Zielen beizutragen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous cherchez un nouveau défi professionnel ? Depuis plus de quatre décennies, notre succès repose sur les 160 employés de Bucher + Suter. Nous sommes le plus grand partenaire de Cisco Contact Center en Europe et un creuset d'esprits innovants, où chaque employé joue un rôle vital dans notre histoire. Si vous êtes passionné par une carrière qui vous défie et vous enrichit, votre quête se termine ici.

Principales tâches

Vous rejoindrez notre équipe d'opérations dynamiques comme un acteur clé dans les projets d'intégration de centres de contact modernes. Vous travaillerez sur place avec des clients, de nos bureaux et à distance. Soyez assuré, vous aurez le soutien d'architectes de solutions expérimentés et d'ingénieurs système.

En tant que personne-ressource centrale pour ces projets, vous vous assurerez qu'ils sont complétés selon des normes élevées, à temps et dans les limites du budget. Votre expertise et votre comportement accessible mobiliseront et motiveront les clients, les partenaires et les membres de l'équipe interne.

Si vous êtes prêt à relever le prochain défi dans la gestion de projet, même si vous ne répondez pas encore à toutes les exigences, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Nous sommes ravis de vous connaître !

Votre profil

• Baccalauréat en informatique, gestion de projet ou ingénierie

• Plus de 5 ans d'expérience à la tête de projets IT, CX numérique, produit numérique, AI ou CRM

• Expérience avec le centre de contact ou les projets d'appel est un plus

• Vous êtes bien tourné dans le cloud et les technologies de communication unifiées; sinon, vous voulez apprendre

• Expérience avec Salesforce ou d'autres solutions CRM est un plus

• Vous appréciez le contact direct avec les clients et les partenaires et avez d'excellentes compétences en communication

• L'expérience avec les ateliers principaux est grandement appréciée

• Vous aimez travailler en équipe, être bien organisé et maintenir la structure dans votre travail

• Vous êtes certifié en gestion de projet et/ou méthodologies agiles (p. ex. PMP, Prince2, IPMA, Scrum, etc.) et idéalement, vous êtes certifié ITILv4

• Vous maîtrisez couramment l'allemand et l'anglais et en plus vous maîtrisez le français

Ce que vous pouvez attendre

• Modèle de travail hybride et outillage moderne

• Possibilités d'avancement professionnel par la formation, les certifications et les cours techniques

• Salaire compétitif avec de grands avantages et avantages

• Culture d'équipe de soutien avec des ingénieurs expérimentés

• Activités des employés, tant sur le plan local qu'international

• Deux jours de congé payé pour les bénévoles par année

Déclaration sur la diversité et l'inclusion

Chez Bucher + Suter, nous croyons que la diversité stimule l'innovation et le succès. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif où tous les employés se sentent valorisés et respectés, peu importe leur passé, leur identité ou leur expérience. Nous accueillons et encourageons les candidats de tous les horizons à rejoindre notre équipe et à contribuer à nos objectifs communs.

jobs.title: Linux System Administrator/Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Linux System Administrator/Engineer, you will work as part of the IT team in our offices in Worblaufen, near Bern, and collaborate directly with colleagues from a variety of Bucher + Suter teams.

You will be responsible for ensuring the stable, secure, and efficient operation of our Linux systems. In this role, you will work closely with project teams and actively contribute your expertise to both ongoing and new initiatives.

Main Tasks

• Operating and further developing the system infrastructure

• Ensuring the stability, security, and availability of the server environment

• Analyzing and resolving issues

• Supporting projects with your expertise and implementing infrastructure requirements

• Automation and standardization

• Documenting system environments, configurations, and operational processes

Your Profile

You meet the key requirements for this role:

• Solid knowledge of Linux system administration, with a focus on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)

• Completed vocational training plus several years of experience in IT operations, or a completed IT vocational training program

• Excellent German and good English skills

Additionally, we would be pleased if you have experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Experience as a Splunk system administrator

• Operation of Windows servers and clients

• Knowledge of MS SQL databases

• Experience with web application firewalls

What you can expect

• Hybrid working model and modern tooling

• An exciting work environment with a wide range of responsibilities

• Opportunities for career advancement through training, certifications, and technical courses

• Flexible work hours to help achieve a good work-life balance

• Supportive team culture with experienced engineers

• Employee events, both locally and internationally

• Two paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) days per year

Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At Bucher + Suter, we believe that diversity drives innovation and success. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued and respected, regardless of their background, identity, or experiences. We welcome and encourage applicants from all walks of life to join our team and contribute to our shared goals.

jobs.title: Salesforce Business Consultant – Agentforce Contact Center + Service Cloud (CH)

titleByLocale.de: Salesforce Business Berater – Agentforce Contact Center + Service Cloud (CH)
titleByLocale.fr: Salesforce Business Consultant – Centre de contact Agentforce + Service Cloud (CH)

jobs.description:
Environment

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Consultant with deep expertise in Service Cloud, capable of owning discovery, solution design, and delivery for complex customer service transformations. This role requires strong functional leadership, the ability to challenge requirements constructively, and the architectural maturity that comes with Salesforce Administrator and Service Cloud Consultant certification.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead discovery sessions with business and technical stakeholders to define service processes, KPIs, and operational needs.

• Design scalable solutions across Agentforce, Service Cloud, Omni-Channel, and Digital Engagement, ensuring alignment with platform best practices.

• Optimize contact center operations by defining routing strategies, agent workflows, and supervisor dashboards.

• Configure and prototype advanced Service Cloud features, including Flows, automations, Knowledge, and Case Management.

• Collaborate with technical teams to guide integration patterns, data models, and LWC component requirements.

• Support UAT and quality assurance to validate solution integrity and ensure a smooth go-live.

• Drive change enablement by preparing training materials, documentation, and adoption strategies.

Requirements

• Salesforce Administrator and Service Cloud Consultant certification.

• Strong hands-on experience with Service Cloud, including Case Management, Omni-Channel, Knowledge, Macros, and automation.

• Proven expertise with Agentforce Contact Center, including routing, telephony integration, agent workspace, and supervisor tools.

• Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable user Stories.

• Experience collaborating with developers on APIs, integrations, and LWC.

• Solid understanding of contact center KPIs, SLAs, and operational models.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in multi-cloud environments, including Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, and Field Service.

• Background in consulting, customer service operations, or CX transformation.

• Familiarity with AI-powered features, including Einstein Bots, Agentforce AI, and Next Best Action.

What we offer

• Hybrid working model and modern tooling

• An exciting work environment with a wide range of responsibilities

• Opportunities for career advancement through training, certifications, and technical courses

• Flexible work hours to help achieve a good work-life balance

• Supportive team culture with experienced engineers

• Employee events, both locally and internationally

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a new professional challenge? Bucher + Suter’s 160 employees have been the cornerstone of our success for over four decades. We are the largest Cisco Contact Center Partner in Europe and a melting pot of innovative minds, where every employee plays a vital role in our story. If you’re passionate about a career that both challenges and enriches you, your quest concludes here.

Responsibilities

You’ll be joining our dynamic operations team as a key player in modern contact center integration projects. You’ll work on-site with customers, from our offices, and remotely. Rest assured, you’ll have the support of experienced solution architects and system engineers.

As the central contact person for these projects, you’ll ensure they are completed to high standards, on time, and within budget. Your expertise and approachable demeanor will engage and motivate customers, partners, and internal team members.

If you’re ready to take the next challenge in project management, even if you don’t meet all the requirements yet, we encourage you to apply. We’re excited to get to know you!

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, project management, or engineering

• More than 5 years of experience leading IT, digital CX, digital product, AI or CRM projects

• Experience with contact center or calling projects is a plus

• You’re well-versed in cloud and unified communications technologies; if not, you want to learn

• Experience with Salesforce or other CRM solutions is a plus

• You enjoy direct contact with customers and partners and have excellent communication skills

• Experience with leading workshops is greatly appreciated

• You enjoy working as part of a team, are well-organized, and maintaining structure in your work

• You are certified in project management and/or agile methodologies (e.g., PMP, Prince2, IPMA, Scrum, etc.) and ideally, you are ITILv4 certified

• You are fluent in French and English and as a plus you are business proficient in German

What you can expect

• Hybrid working model and modern tooling

• Opportunities for career advancement through training, certifications, and technical courses

• Competitive salary with great benefits and perks

• Supportive team culture with experienced engineers

• Employee events, both locally and internationally

• Two paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) days per year
